reason: Two harness-gateway coroutines left un-awaited by #939. (1) harness_core_tools.call_core_tool's SubagentWaitPending branch called the now-async _invoking_child, wait_ready and wait_result without await, so a harness subagent's message_parent(wait_for_reply) failed at once instead of waiting for the parent's answer. (2) PermissionTicket.acknowledge_handoff called the async record_adapter_handoff without await, so every Codex/Grok/Claude SDK approval kept adapter_status 'pending'. Awaiting the receipt exposed a revision race between the decision task's record_delivery and the adapter's receipt on the same approval; both now reread and replan after a revision conflict. Selected: the approval handoff suite (new real-consumer, product-ticket and race tests plus the 4 contract tests that were red on main), the adapter and Codex transport suites that build permission tickets, the passing approval-continuation delivery tests, the harness subagent suite repaired in this change (new gateway question test) minus three load-sensitive cases, and the Grok/Codex permission-answer and harness approval-policy cases.
exclusions: No full suites; no frontend, native or Playwright changes (Core-only fix, no UI). Excluded because they fail identically on pristine origin/main for reasons this change does not touch: test_approval_continuation.py::test_cancelled_waiter_does_not_resurrect_terminal_turn and ::test_resolving_one_request_keeps_the_other_pending; 5 test_grok_acp_compliance, 4 test_harness_leftovers, 1 test_codex_turn_outcomes, 4 test_subagent_refusal_categories, 17 test_universal_agent_tools and 22 test_chat_subagents cases (identical failure sets on main and branch); test_harnesses.py::test_late_approval_decision_does_not_break_the_gateway and ::test_harness_api_chat_mission_handoff_and_catalog (same assertion failures on main). test_harness_provider_subagents.py was inert on main (un-awaited prepare_chat); of its repaired cases, test_harness_subagent_stop_cancels_its_harness_turn, test_harness_mission_supervisor_uses_chat_gateway_and_records_child and test_operator_limit_reaches_the_harness_and_is_enforced hit pre-existing load-dependent races (subagent.stop revision conflict, 5 s waits, prepare_chat session revision conflict) with or without this fix, so they are not selected. test_terminal_core.py is only updated to the async receipt contract; its approval case fails on main for unrelated reasons. Other suites importing _prepare (subagent_delivery, mcp_catalog_reads, subagent_start_replay, universal_agent_tools, subagent_refusal_categories) still call it without await, exactly as on main; not repaired here. No live provider or harness accounts and no Core deployment.
